subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this umbrella continue to coordinate the remaining multi-agent stability work, or should maintainers close it only after transferring every unique symptom to narrower canonical issues?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the remaining failure modes require maintainer choices about session ownership, completion-delivery semantics, and how far OpenClaw should go toward a broader orchestration layer under VISION.md guardrails.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Use this issue as the coordinator while focused PRs/issues land for config mutation, lock ownership, fallback lanes, and completion delivery, then close it when the central user workflow is proven stable.

options.title: Split To Canonicals
options.body: Move every unique symptom into narrower issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89927, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92433, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975, then close this only after linking the preserved evidence.

options.title: Sponsor Broader Design
options.body: Treat the comments proposing token-ring or metadata-only completion as a new RFC and decide the product direction before more piecemeal fixes proceed.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the coordinator while focused PRs/issues land for config mutation, lock ownership, fallback lanes, and completion delivery, then close it when the central user workflow is proven stable.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history place Vincent closest to the central session, config, subagent, and auth code paths that need coordination.
